What differentiates power-users from ordinary peasant folk?

I'd have to say there are a few things that set the two apart.

Power-users often browse a variety of subs, and aren't stuck in one sub. They contribute to all aspects of Voat. Often, this goes hand in hand with seniority, since the older the user, the more chances there are that they'll explore more parts of the website.

Peasants are users who are fixated on a small number of subs, don't contribute much (be it comments, submissions, or votes). Often, coincidentally, new users.

It's not to say there are no old peasants or young power users, those exist too, but I think they're fewer.
